scope_statement: Earlier-learning science foundations for Hiraia’s Grade 3 entry route, anchored to selected Kindergarten 2016 competencies. This is not a complete Grade 2 Makabansa crosswalk or proof of an individual learner’s classroom coverage.
claim_limit: Narrow recall/recognition only; no school readiness, grade placement, full competency mastery, or calibrated form-equivalence claim.

deped-kindergarten-2016.title: K to 12 Kindergarten Curriculum Guide, May 2016
deped-kindergarten-2016.verification: Official PDF and page-preserving text inspected locally. Text extraction hash is pinned; anchors preserve official printed codes, including spaces. The weather code PNEKE-00-1 appears twice on page 23.

benchmark_constructs.construct: Recall the function of a familiar basic body part or sense.
Recognize a familiar animal or plant need or care action.
